title: Featured Projects
subtitle: Selected work spanning mobile, backend, and product delivery

items.name: Office Gossip
items.overview: An anonymous workplace community platform for employees of verified companies — anonymous posting, trending feeds, member directories, and push notifications. Designed and shipped end to end as a solo developer, spanning cross-platform Flutter apps, member and admin web portals, and a secure REST API with automated cloud deployments.
responsibilities: Designed and built the entire product solo: product scope, database design, REST API, Flutter app, both React web apps, push notifications, email delivery, and deployment.
Built the Flutter app with feature-based Clean Architecture, BLoC/Cubit, GetIt, GoRouter, and fpdart Either for typed error handling.
Developed ~50 REST endpoints in Node.js 22, Express 5, and TypeScript with Zod validation, deployed as a Firebase Cloud Function behind Hosting rewrites.
Modelled 13 PostgreSQL tables on Supabase covering companies, memberships, posts, comments, reports, devices, and announcements.
Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that detects changes and deploys only the affected web app, admin dashboard, or backend to Firebase on merge.
challenges: Keeping posts truly anonymous to members while still recording authors internally so moderators can act.
Verifying real employment with admin-approved company memberships, since a company email domain alone isn't proof.
Locking down data access so only the backend touches the database, checking login, role, and active membership on every request.
Keeping users signed in securely with Dio interceptors that attach and automatically refresh tokens.

items.name: TableTalk Bill
items.overview: A B2B SaaS platform for GST billing and job costing, built for electrical, plumbing, construction and building-service contractors. Each contractor business gets its own private account for site quotations, GST invoices, payments, labour, a ledger book and reports, while the platform owner onboards businesses and manages the shared product catalogue from a separate admin console.
responsibilities: Designed and built the entire product solo: database design, REST API, the contractor web app, the admin console and deployment.
Kept every contractor business's data — customers, quotations, bills, prices, payments and labour — private to its own account.
Built a server-side billing engine for Indian GST (CGST/SGST and IGST), discounts, offer prices, round-off and financial-year invoice numbering.
Built a mobile-first site-quote flow for contractors on site, with quotations saved offline and uploaded automatically when the connection returns.
Deployed the API on Cloudflare Workers with a Supabase PostgreSQL database, and wrote database migration, backup and restore scripts.
challenges: Sharing one product catalogue across all businesses while keeping each business's own prices private.
Letting the platform owner manage businesses — onboarding, deactivation, device sign-out and maintenance mode — without exposing any business's revenue or bank details.
Generating print-ready PDF invoices, quotations and payment receipts that can be shared to customers on WhatsApp directly from the phone.
Importing large product lists from CSV and Google Sheets with validation before import and inline error fixing.

items.name: The Super Test
items.overview: An education and exam-prep learning app for aspirants targeting SSC GD, Railway, and other government competitive exams — built with Clean Architecture and BLoC, following the same scalable patterns used in My Gym Orbit.
responsibilities: Built learning and practice flows for SSC GD, Railway, and related competitive exam content using Clean Architecture with BLoC.
Structured domain, data, and presentation layers for quizzes, mock tests, and study modules with clear dependency rules.
challenges: Organizing large exam-oriented question banks and subject modules while keeping the architecture modular and testable.
Delivering a smooth learning experience across practice tests, progress tracking, and content updates.

items.name: My Gym Orbit
items.overview: A cross-platform gym management app with attendance, booking, chat, and AI fitness support.
responsibilities: Built the app with Clean Architecture, BLoC/Cubit, and get_it for scalable modules.
Implemented attendance, trainer booking with Stripe, and member chat.
Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD for Android and iOS releases.
challenges: Supporting multiple check-in methods (NFC, QR, geo-fencing, manual) in one attendance flow.
Keeping Clean Architecture maintainable as chat, payments, and AI features grew.
